stem.text: Two quantities $p$ and $q$ are directly proportional to each other.
Experimental results are taken and plotted in a graph of $q$ against $p$.
Which graph shows there were random errors in the measurements of $p$ and $q$?

A.alt: Graph with axes q (vertical) and p (horizontal), origin marked 0, crosses and a straight line through the origin.

B.alt: Graph with axes q (vertical) and p (horizontal), origin marked 0, crosses and a curved line from the origin.

C.alt: Graph with axes q (vertical) and p (horizontal), origin marked 0, crosses and a straight line through the origin.

D.alt: Graph with axes q (vertical) and p (horizontal), origin marked 0, crosses and a straight line that meets the q axis above the origin.
